message.content:
The full capacity of the workshop is determined by adding the seating capacity from the benches and the standing places. With 7 benches each seating 3 people, the seating capacity is 7 × 3 = 21. Adding the 5 standing places gives a total capacity of 21 + 5 = 26.  
26
